question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Recent guides equal prior actual x ~1.12-1.145 (81.6->91, 96.2->108). Q3 beats have run 4.6-5.7%, implying Q3 actual ~$113-114B and a Q4 guide ~$127-128B. Street Q4 consensus $124.3B; the last guide beat pre-report consensus by 3.6%; Wells Fargo expects $126.4B and a guide above consensus. Downside: supply/memory constraints, China excluded, CEO probe could make management cautious. No market prices the Q4 guide; the Polymarket contracts are on Q3 DC revenue (implied median ~$105B, thin volume) and serve only as evidence.
calls.dossier:
- Q1 FY27 (reported 2026-05-20): revenue $81.6B, DC $75.2B; Q2 guide was ~$91B +/-2% (CNBC/Yahoo). The Q1 FY27 guide was ~$78B (recollection, not verified this run).
- Q2 FY27 (2026-08-26): revenue $96.2B (+18% QoQ) vs $92.3B consensus; DC $89.0B; Q3 guide $108B +/-2% vs $104.2B expected; China DC compute excluded (CoinDesk, NVIDIA PR).
- Guide / prior actual: 91/81.6=1.115; 108/96.2=1.123. Successive guides rose by +13B (78->91) and +17B (91->108). Actual vs guide: Q1 +4.6%, Q2 +5.7%.
- Q3 FY27 consensus ranges $108.8B-$111.4B across sources; IG says $109.2B; one Seeking Alpha preview says ~$113B (IG, 2026-11-10; Yahoo/MarketBeat).
- Street Q4 FY27 revenue consensus is $124.3B; Wells Fargo is at $126.4B and expects a guide above consensus on supply execution (TipRanks, ~Nov 2026).
- Mgmt has said gross margin bottoms at 71-72% in Q4 FY27 on memory costs; demand for Blackwell/Vera Rubin outstrips supply; Rubin is ~1/5 of Q3 DC revenue (IG).
- The board is investigating CEO Huang over an alleged relationship with a Chinese businesswoman, alleged to have facilitated about $7.5B of shipments; stock fell 4-5% on consecutive days (TipRanks/IG).
- Huang forecast ~70% FY28 revenue growth in August (CNBC).
- Resolves off the midpoint of the Q4 FY27 revenue range in the Outlook section of the Q3 FY27 press release, rounded to the nearest $B, not off actual Q4 revenue.
- Event window: release expected 2026-11-17; as of 2026-11-10 the guide is not yet published.
- Searched for but not found: any market on the Q4 guide itself, and the exact Q4 FY26 actual and Q1 FY27 guide figures (not verified).

calls.reconciliation: All runs share the same guide history and consensus figures. Q3 actual (111-114B) is unresolvable before the release; I used ~113B based on the beat pattern and the Polymarket Q3 DC ladder (evidence only, wrong contract). The FY27 full-year consensus of 418.7B, which implies a Q4 near 130B, conflicts with the 124.3B Q4 consensus and can't be settled offline, so I gave it little weight beyond a mild upside lean. The weight on management caution is judgment; China is already excluded, so the scandal has limited direct effect on the guide. I kept the runs' ~11B dispersion and set the median at 127, matching the guide-ratio and step-growth arithmetic.
